notes.title: Dragon Drop has been submitted!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to announce we've just finished the process of submitting our game to Steam for review. A big thanks to everyone for being patient over the last few weeks as we made sure the game had the polish it deserved before release. 

Dragon Drop will launch on November 8th! There will be a 20% launch discount for 1 week. There will be an update to add extra hard mode levels to the game before the end of the year.

Thank you again and please enjoy!

- James
~Squish Studios~
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30558695/3aa372ce0fc989e00ce6d0a759593d8e1e9e437e.png
